note: Family-run 67-acre ranch campground of woodland and pasture on the south edge of Crescent City, a Redwood National Park gateway. Sites are spread out among the trees, with chemical toilets nearby; restrooms, coin showers and Wi-Fi are at the office. Horse paddocks are in a separate horse area (horses are never allowed in campsites), and no horse is needed to camp. Navigate by the ranch name: the street address leads into a neighboring subdivision. --Claude
summary: Orman Guest Ranch (private, Crescent City): rates confirmed $24 (1-2 people) to $32 (4) with +$4/person, $7 booking fee, $3 dog; season now dated 05-26 to 09-12 (2027 posted); operator booking with a holiday 2-night minimum; Google 4.7 (150). Not a long-stay park; horse area separate. Not waterfront stands.
flags: GOOGLE: 4.7 stars, 150 reviews (Orman Guest Ranch & Stables).

LONG-STAY: not a long-stay park - nightly, per-person pricing only, no weekly/monthly rates posted; tents and RVs alike, so the nightly share is effectively 100%. No discouraging wording; the homepage welcomes 'a weekend getaway, a week-long adventure, or an extended stay'.
PRICE GATE: $24 for 2 people - well under $50.
HORSE: general campground with horse paddocks; the conduct page keeps horses in a separate HORSE AREA ('never in any campsite'), so it passes the horse-camp rule.
FIT: the FAQ says 'most of our sites have plenty of room for your trailer or RV'; no length limit posted.

PIN: stored 41.74720,-124.15920 sits on the fenced paddock grid (horse area); Google's place point 41.74624,-124.15673 is the entrance by the office ~230 m ESE. The campsites are spread through the woodland to the west and south and cannot be picked out on imagery, so no move proposed (under 250 m from the office either way).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands; the old note's '~2 mi (about 250 yds through the woods) from the Pacific' was self-contradictory and is dropped. The stored evidence (coastal road and forest band between camp and shore, no line of sight) still rules out a coastal value; not re-measured.
Potable water not stated on any page read (old note: 'water spigots'); left unchanged.
